items.criterion: The agent declares how many graded forward passes it spent and which split it fitted its calibration on, and it is not a split it is graded on.
items.judgment: VALUE: The run record's agent_budget_declaration parses and carries an integer graded_forward_passes of at least one and a calibration_fit_split naming one or both of clean_train and clean_val, the two labelled splits that ship. Naming corrupted_graded or clean_graded fails with reason fit_on_graded_split; that is this slot's second intended failure mode, fitting temperature on the corrupted split it is graded on, written down as something a checker can read. Any other name fails with reason unknown_fit_split. The declaration is what is graded and the harness's own measurement is not, so this cannot be satisfied by a field the harness writes; and a declaration that is false rather than absent is reached by heldout_label_isolation instead, since fitting on a graded split requires that split's labels.

items.criterion: Contract checker obligation CK-BINFAM is discharged: the ordering against CTL-NOOP survives every member of the binning family.
items.judgment: INVARIANT: Under a binning family fixed by construction -- bin counts 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 75 and 100 crossed with equal-width and equal-mass edges, twenty members, none of which is the graded scheme -- the verifier recomputes ECE for the submission and for CTL-NOOP on every cell of the 19x5 grid, and separately under the graded bin edges, which are pinned by sha256 in the bundle's constants and are never read from any submitted file. Equal-mass edges are the quantiles of CTL-NOOP's confidence vector over the same cells (inputs only; no label is consulted to place an edge), computed once per grading run and applied unchanged to every candidate, so no candidate is ever measured under edges fitted to its own outputs and both candidates are always measured under identical partitions. For each of the twenty-one members the verifier forms each candidate's mean ECE over the 95 cells; the sign of (ECE of CTL-NOOP minus ECE of the submission) must be non-zero and identical under all twenty-one, so that the ordering against the control is not an artifact of a single binning. All per-member and per-cell ECEs are written to the verifier record only and are returned to no agent-visible channel, each being a function of the private corrupted labels. The family is derived entirely from the single stored per-sample (confidence, correctness) record of the graded inference pass: it adds no forward pass, no label read beyond the graded one, and no change to the declared budget. Scope: this establishes only that the ordering against CTL-NOOP is binning-independent; it does not discharge the rejection of CTL-GRADEDBINS, which passes this invariant and requires its own obligation. Two implementation facts settle what the wording leaves open. Equal-width members span the observed confidence range of the shared record rather than [0, 1], which is what makes the twenty alternates disjoint from the pinned partition: a 15-bin equal-width member laid over [0, 1] would BE the graded scheme, and the contract requires that none of them is. The two outermost edges of every member are then widened to cover both candidates, so that no row of either falls outside all bins and is dropped from its own mean. The compiled body fails closed with reason control_record_absent when the run record carries no per-sample (confidence, correctness) record for CTL-NOOP, because with no control there is no ordering to be invariant and reporting one would be reporting nothing.

items.criterion: Control CTL-GRADEDBINS is rejected: the submitted confidences are not a lookup fitted to the private corrupted fold under the pinned graded partition.
items.judgment: ABSENCE: Red line 2 forbids fitting calibration on the graded binning scheme and, until this item, nothing enforced it; seed/contract.yaml records the shortfall in checker_obligations_shortfall and this obligation is offered against it. The finding is one measured fact: over the 19000 corrupted rows, the expected calibration error under the PINNED partition is at most 1e-06, meaning every one of the 15 bins has its mean confidence equal to its accuracy to within a millionth. That is not a demanding bar cleared by a good solve, it is a bar no solve can clear. A perfectly calibrated probabilistic model still carries binomial sampling noise, so its bins miss their own accuracy by about the square root of one over the bin count -- of order 0.007 across 19000 rows -- and the shipped starter measures about 0.14 while a ten-bin histogram honestly fitted on the clean fold measures about 0.03. A value below 1e-06 sits four orders of magnitude under the statistical floor and is reachable only by setting each bin's confidence to the accuracy THESE labels give it. The failure reason is calibrated_to_float_precision_on_the_pinned_partition. Two corroborating figures ride in the evidence and gate nothing: the calibration error under a strict refinement of the same partition, each pinned bin split ten ways, and the number of distinct confidence levels. Both were tried as required clauses and both were wrong. A distinct-value count is defeated by arithmetic noise, because renormalising a re-weighted row sums 100 floats in an order that depends on which class holds the mass, so a fifteen-valued lookup emerges carrying thousands of float64 maxima that differ in the last unit in the last place. A refinement clause is worse than brittle, it is unsound: a lookup whose every value equals the accuracy of the rows carrying it is calibrated under EVERY partition that separates its values, so refining the bins reveals nothing at all. That property is why the coarse-partition reading is decisive on its own. Scope, stated rather than overclaimed. Evading the detector means moving off exact calibration under the pinned partition, which is the entire benefit of having fitted to it, so evasion costs the thing it protects -- but a partial fit that surrenders most of that benefit does pass here. And the detector convicts a neighbour of CTL-GRADEDBINS as well as CTL-GRADEDBINS itself: a lookup fitted to the graded fold under the agent's own partition lands at the same signature. That is red line 1, any read of the private corrupted splits' labels, rather than red line 2; catching it here is not a false positive, because both are red lines and both score zero.

items.criterion: Clean accuracy stays inside the bound tolerance, which is what makes a flattened posterior fail rather than win.
items.judgment: VALUE: Top-1 accuracy of the clean block -- rows 19000 through 28999 argmaxed against the 10000 private clean labels -- must be at least clean_accuracy_floor. UNMEASURED AT PHASE 0: clean_accuracy_floor is null because the tolerance is a band around the reference model's own clean accuracy, which the Phase 2 wave measures on the grading host and which Phase 0 must not invent; the body calls require_measured first and raises ConstantUnmeasured rather than returning a score. This is the gate seed/contract.yaml names as the mitigation for the uniform-posterior shortcut, and it is the only place the price can be charged: a uniform posterior genuinely does lower expected calibration error, so nothing in the corrupted objective punishes it and the corrupted objective cannot be hardened into punishing it. The clean fold ships unlabelled to the agent for exactly this reason.

items.criterion: The macro-averaged corrupted calibration error clears the published bar and maps through the reward ramp.
items.judgment: VALUE: The mean of the 95 per-cell expected calibration errors over the private corrupted labels, computed under the pinned 15-bin equal-width partition, mapped to the higher-is-better axis as 1 minus that mean and then through the floor-to-knee ramp published in tests/constants.json. UNMEASURED AT PHASE 0: floor, knee and dichotomizing_threshold are null, so require_measured is this body's FIRST statement and it raises ConstantUnmeasured before the submission is opened at all. The ordering is load-bearing rather than stylistic. Reading the submission first would let a missing file raise its own error, the verifier would report gradeable true with r_det 0.0, and "not yet measurable" would have been written down as "the agent scored zero" -- which is the one distinction the whole null-constant convention exists to keep, and which seed/build/freeze_batch.py refuses to freeze around. The per-cell vector and the worst cell travel in the verifier record only; each is a function of the private corrupted labels and none reaches any agent-visible channel.

items.criterion: The graded run writes into neither the checker tree nor the private label store.
items.judgment: ABSENCE: The run record's guarded_paths_touched list is empty, and the evidence names any entry falling under tests/, naming tests/heldout/corrupted_graded_labels.npz or tests/heldout/clean_graded_labels.npz, or falling under the verifier's own output directory. The list is read from the harness record the run itself produced and never from a scan taken afterwards, because a post-hoc scan cannot tell a write made during the graded run from one made before it. An absent run record fails closed with reason run_record_absent rather than passing vacuously, which is the only way this check can be wrong in the agent's favour.

items.criterion: The agent holds no copy of either private label vector, at any of the three lengths a copy can take here.
items.judgment: ABSENCE: No file collected under agent_src matches tests/heldout/corrupted_graded_labels.npz or tests/heldout/clean_graded_labels.npz by sha256, and no integer array the agent wrote equals the 19000-entry corrupted label vector, the 10000-entry clean label vector, or the 200-entry cell vector. That third length is the one that matters and is the reason this check is not the generic label-isolation check: the same 200 CIFAR-100 test images are corrupted into all 95 cells, so the 19000-entry vector is 95 tilings of one 200-entry vector and an agent holding 200 integers holds every graded corrupted label there is. A check watching only for a 19000-long array would miss a complete leak 99 percent smaller than the thing it was watching for. Absence is established from committed bytes rather than from intent, and an uncollected agent_src fails closed with reason agent_source_unavailable.

items.criterion: All 95 per-cell calibration errors are computed and the worst cell is named, so one catastrophic corruption cannot hide inside an average.
items.judgment: VALUE: The verifier forms one expected calibration error per (corruption, severity) cell over that cell's 200 rows under the pinned 15-bin partition. The check passes when all 95 are finite and the record names the worst cell by corruption name and severity -- glass_blur at severity 5, say -- beside the macro average and the pooled 19000-row figure. Macro and pooled differ, and the difference is the point: the calibration error takes an absolute value inside each bin, so it does not commute with averaging across cells, and a submission well calibrated on 94 cells and catastrophically overconfident on the 95th is closer to the fleet average in the pooled figure than in the macro one. The ramp reads the macro figure and the pooled figure travels beside it so the gap is visible rather than assumed away. Because one fixed draw of 200 test images is corrupted into every cell, the 95 numbers are 95 readings of the same image set and the macro average weights all 19 corruptions equally at each severity without any reweighting.

items.criterion: The partition the score is read under is the one pinned in the bundle, not one the graded run supplied.
items.judgment: INVARIANT: tests/graded_bin_edges.npy still hashes to c77dbd3cceaaa09553e163c37b8e8aa01cbeaa48ea2f99626faf4a2c45a3a200 after the graded run, its 16 float64 entries are exactly the equal-width partition of [0, 1] into 15 bins, and no path naming graded_bin_edges appears in the run record's guarded_paths_touched. The edges are read from the bundle and never from a submitted file, so a run that rewrote them into a partition its own confidences sit comfortably inside fails with reason pinned_binning_moved rather than quietly changing the axis the ramp is read on. This is the one check in the set that passes at Phase 0, because the pinned instrument is authored and present today while every quantity read through it is not.

items.criterion: The graded run leaves a loadable floating-point posterior at the declared submission path.
items.judgment: EFFECT: /submission/confidences.npy exists and loads through numpy with allow_pickle false into an array whose dtype kind is floating. An object dtype, a pickled payload, an unreadable file, or an integer label vector of the kind a classification family would submit all fail here with reason posterior_unloadable, which separates an artifact that cannot be read from one that reads and is wrong. This slot grades a distribution, not a decision, so an integer array is not a degraded submission but a different object.

items.criterion: The 29000 by 100 posterior reproduces byte for byte from the recorded seed.
items.judgment: EFFECT: The sha256 of /submission/confidences.npy equals replay_artifact_sha256, the digest the run record carries from the agent's own second run under its recorded seed. Byte identity rather than numeric closeness is required because the graded quantity is a binned statistic: a rerun that reorders one reduction and moves a single confidence across one of the 15 pinned edges changes the calibration error it is scored on while looking numerically identical to any tolerance a reviewer would think to apply. An absent digest fails with reason replay_unavailable and a differing one with reason replay_diverged.

items.criterion: Every row is a probability vector over the 100 fine labels, not merely a vector that sums to one.
items.judgment: INVARIANT: All 29000 rows are finite, carry no negative entry, and sum to 1 within 1e-06. Non-negativity is checked separately from unit mass because the two are separately falsifiable here: a row holding -0.4 beside 1.4 sums to one, and its top-1 confidence of 1.4 lands outside every bin of the pinned partition, so it would be dropped from the calibration error it is supposed to be scored on rather than penalised by it. That case fails with reason negative_mass; a row summing to 1.0004 fails with reason row_mass_out_of_tolerance.

items.criterion: The array carries the 19000 corrupted graded rows and the 10000 clean graded rows in the one pinned stacking order.
items.judgment: INVARIANT: The array is two-dimensional with exactly 29000 rows and exactly 100 columns. Rows 0 through 18999 are the corruption grid in the corpus's own order, corruption_id equal to the row index divided by 1000 and severity equal to the row index modulo 1000 divided by 200 plus one, cross-checked cell for cell against the corruption_id and severity arrays inside environment/data/corrupted_graded.npz; rows 19000 through 28999 are the clean graded fold in environment/data/clean_graded.npz file order. A 19000-row array is the interesting failure and gets its own reason, clean_block_missing: it grades the corruption objective perfectly well and leaves the clean-accuracy tolerance gate nothing to read, which is exactly how the uniform-posterior shortcut would like to be graded. Any other row count fails with reason wrong_row_count and nothing is trimmed or padded to fit; 20 columns, the CIFAR-100 coarse-label domain, fails with reason wrong_class_count.

items.criterion: The compiled rejection of control CTL-UNIFORM: the submission is not the flat 1/100 posterior that lowers calibration error by having no prediction left to be wrong about.
items.judgment: ABSENCE: CTL-UNIFORM emits 0.01 in every one of the 29000 by 100 entries. Its calibration error is |accuracy - 0.01|, and chance accuracy over 100 fine labels IS 0.01, so it scores a near-zero calibration error while predicting nothing at all; that is why the shortcut is real rather than theoretical. Three facts are checked and all three must hold: the 29000 rows are not all equal to the uniform vector within 1e-09; the top-1 confidence over the 19000 corrupted rows takes at least two distinct values; and the argmax over the 10000 clean rows covers at least two of the 100 classes. Any failure reports reason uniform_posterior. This item catches only the degenerate endpoint; the graded near-uniform cases are priced by clean_accuracy_tolerance, which is where the contract puts the mitigation.
